description: This file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface in the Orleans.Hosting namespace, enabling configuration of Redis as a grain storage provider with various options.

classes.name: RedisSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure Redis storage.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures Redis as the default grain storage provider with optional configuration.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures Redis as a grain storage provider with specified name and optional configuration.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Overload for adding Redis storage as default without additional configuration.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorage
methods.description: Overload for adding Redis storage with a name, without additional configuration.
